description: Phase 3 sweep S9 (E13): exact context loading versus the trained HEA context loader (Sec. III, MSE + SPSA, L = 4, 3000 epochs), with and without the leading Hadamard layer drawn in Fig. 4, for the paper HEA QSTL and the context-preserving order-1 circuit (E11). QBGU, SWAP-test loss, 3000 SPSA iterations x 10,000 shots. Raw and MA5 data; classical baselines rerun as reference. Evaluation matrix: no winner selected.

secondary_metrics: context-preserving fidelity bound from the loaded state (utils/plot_phase3_s9.py)
evaluation.split: test = chronological last 20 % of T+1 windows
evaluation.checkpoint: final iteration for quantum models; validation-selected refit for baselines
evaluation.aggregation: mean and sample standard deviation over seeds; paired-by-seed differences with a 95 % t interval
evaluation.tie_rule: a paired difference whose 95 % interval contains 0 is reported as not distinguishable
